description: Start a CLI agent in its own tmux window and return its agent_id (use it with send_text, send_key, read, kill) and run_id. Omit run_id to add the agent to this MCP session run, created on the first spawn so a chain of spawns stays in one run; pass run_id to add it to an existing run. Call list_providers for valid provider keys.

auth_mode.description: How the CLI authenticates. Blank uses the provider default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, for providers that support it. Blank uses the provider default.

extra_args.description: Extra flags appended verbatim to the launch, for provider options ReevesAgents does not model. Each flag and its value is a separate item, e.g. ["--remote-control"].

model.description: Model id. Blank keeps the provider default.

name.description: Run name when starting a new run.

permissions.description: ask prompts for each action; skip runs autonomously. Blank uses the global default.

provider.description: Provider key, e.g. cc, codex, kimi, qwen, opencode, hermes.

run_id.description: Add to this run. Omit to start a new run.

task.description: Initial prompt pasted into the agent on startup.

name: spawn
